title: Planning a synthesis
caption: Start from the target and the available starting materials; choose reactions that build the carbon skeleton and install the functional groups; consider conditions, yield, safety and purification at each step; then confirm the product by analysis.
alt: A flow: target → identify key bonds and groups → choose reactions and conditions → carry out and purify → analyse.
description: Work out which bonds and groups must be made.
Choose reactions, conditions and the order of steps.
Purify and confirm by melting point, IR and NMR.
